messages:
Ravi K.: Heads-up: exported audit ndjson contains near-duplicates for policy edits (same actor, same policy, different event_id within 1-3s). Saw it during a canary. Anyone dug into how to present this?
Elena M.: Yep. Root cause usually multiple producers emitting (console + infra webhook). We can't drop events for compliance customers.
Jun L.: Two directions: backend dedupe (dangerous) vs UI clustering (safer). I propose we emit a non-destructive hint: cluster_key = sha256(tenant_salt + actor + policy + action + minute_bucket). Optional field, doesn't remove raw_event.* lines.
Kelly B.: UX: timeline should cluster by default with an expand action to reveal raw events and their producers. Show a small badge like "3 events" and a reason.
Ravi K.: Privacy/legal: salted hashes still pseudonymous. For legal mappings we need a reversible lookup. Can we bundle mapping tables only in privileged export bundles?
Jun L.: Yes. Manifest fields: schema header line (#schema:route-audit.v2), export_mode: raw|clustered, pii_mapping_included: yes|no, pii_mapping_location: s3://..., dedupe_window_seconds: 30. Raw NDJSON still contains raw_event.* entries. cluster_key is optional.
Elena M.: Ops: mapping bundles stored under separate KMS alias, short presigned links, audit-bot entry for every privileged download.
audit-bot: action recorded: privileged_export_requested by Ravi K. (env:prod, id:exp_202603).
OpsBot: Reminder: billing unaffected; events emitted count against quotas even if clustered in Console. Add metrics audit.clustered_count and audit.raw_count.
Kelly B.: Also add compatibility warning in download modal if tenant connectors expect v1. We'll show schema version and an "SIEM compatibility" hint.
Jun L.: I'll open a small PR adding cluster_key + manifest fields to route-audit-proto and include sample NDJSON header. Will include note about tenant-salt and mapping bundle generation.
Ravi K.: Let's run a 48h sample job to pick dedupe window (30s default but can change). Sam, can you schedule?
OpsBot: Scheduled: audit-delta-sampler job for 48h (owner: Sam R.).
Elena M.: I'll draft privacy blurb and legal will review.
Ravi K.: Thanks. Post PR link here and we'll quick-review. :thumbsup:
